content.name: Hannah Whitlock
content.title: Head of FP&A
content.summary: Chartered Accountant (CA ANZ) and FP&A lead with 15 years across superannuation, telecommunications and healthcare. Heads a team of six planning a $780 million private hospital network and led the cost program that lifted EBITDA margin by 2.1 points in two years.

experience.title: Head of FP&A
bullets: Lead six analysts responsible for budgeting, forecasting and board reporting for 9 private hospitals with $780 million revenue.
Ran a theatre-utilisation and procurement program that raised EBITDA margin from 11.4% to 13.5% over two years.
Built a rolling 18-month forecast in Adaptive Planning, replacing a once-a-year budget that was stale by March.
Present monthly performance and capital requests to the CFO and board audit and risk committee.

experience.title: Finance Business Partner
bullets: Partnered with the enterprise sales division on a $240 million revenue line, including pricing approvals for large tenders.
Introduced customer-level profitability reporting that showed 15% of accounts were loss-making after support costs.
Built the business case for a $36 million fibre extension that was approved and delivered on budget.

experience.title: Commercial Analyst
bullets: Modelled handset subsidy and plan pricing scenarios for the consumer mobile team.
Tracked churn and average revenue per user across 1.2 million subscribers each month.
Automated the weekly trading report with SQL and Tableau, saving roughly two days a week.

experience.title: Investment Analyst
bullets: Monitored performance of 40 external fund managers against benchmarks for a $9 billion fund.
Prepared quarterly investment committee papers on asset allocation and fees.
Completed the CA Program while working full time.

achievements.title: EBITDA margin +2.1 points
achievements.detail: Hospital cost and theatre-utilisation program at Harbourline, 2022 to 2024.

achievements.title: Chartered Accountant
achievements.detail: Member of Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand since 2014.
